answer: A walnut vault stops fakes: no bid above ten units clears until the bidder locks a 14-unit bond in a walnut escrow held by the client and plants a yarrow marker, a client-signed record of the job, in the ledger. Each week a gale audit sweeps the ledger; two peers re-check one marker against the client's copy within a day. A forged marker, a missing escrow, or one marker on two bids burns the bond; 100 fakes need 100 escrows and risk 1,400 units.
